domain_boundaries.description: Cross-border financial operations for Indian founders with US subsidiaries (India LLP parent + Delaware C-Corp child)
domain_boundaries.scope_boundary: Single-org financial OS covering accounting, payroll, tax, compliance, and transfer pricing for a two-entity India-US structure. NOT a general multi-currency ERP.

actor_map.role: Primary operator. Runs payroll, manages ledger, files compliance, approves transfers.
Consumes filing-ready exports (GSTR, 24Q, 26Q, Form 5472). Needs schema-compliant data.
Receives salary slips, documents. Passive — no login.
Revenue source of truth for US billing. Live API sync.
Indian regulatory filing targets. System must produce machine-readable uploads.
